RESEARCH & PUBLICATIONSSPATIAL INTERACTION · PERCEPTION · BEHAVIOR MODELING

Between human intention
and virtual action.

Extended reality (XR) opens new possibilities for how people engage with information, express ideas, and act across physical and digital worlds. Realizing this potential requires interfaces grounded in human perception and action, and responsive to diverse abilities and intentions. By bringing together empirical studies, interaction design, and computational models of human performance, this research seeks to establish the foundations for XR systems that expand human capabilities and enable new forms of learning, creation, and collaboration.
